self_found_defects_this_pass: The degeneracy criterion used the lower percentile of bootstrap sample eigengaps. Ordered sample eigenvalues repel, so a truly degenerate pair reports a strictly positive gap in every replicate and that estimator essentially never includes zero, reporting near-degenerate axes as resolved. Replaced with a basic-bootstrap interval for the population gap, 2*gap_hat - upper_quantile, which included zero for an equal-eigenvalue pair (-0.59) and stayed positive for a separated pair (64.33).

derive_D_end_to_end computed degeneracy blocks then ignored them, so a candidate rank could cut through an unresolved block. derive_production_D now evaluates separation at block boundaries; the admissible set is always a subset of 1..D_PA so this can only reduce D, and a test asserts that.

The config validator could fail open if PyYAML were absent and the fallback parser mis-parsed: few keys walked, zero violations reported vacuously. It now requires all eight sections and at least 30 keys.
run_production_D_derivation ignored its audit argument; it now cross-checks loaded strata against audited cell and pair counts and STOPs on drift.

Three of my own test expectations were wrong rather than the code: a weighted-quantile median whose exact value is 2 + 50/50.5, an arbitrary 1.5x null-eigenvalue margin, and a no-fallback STOP that is actually D=1. Each was replaced with an analytic or measured assertion rather than a loosened tolerance, and a fabricated spectrum-concentration threshold was removed after measuring that it varied 2.0x to 20.3x across seeds.
